predictions.claim: Expected detections per entry: no entry is detected. Every Go entry derives no law (no rule producer takes a Go-only document without a target sidecar), and the Solidity entries either fail extraction or derive only generic DISCH, SYM, UNDO, FACT or typed SORT laws over zero storage, none of which is a REFUTED law of the entry's label rule meeting the fix's lines.

Extraction reach on foreign code: c17 (a contract repository whose units import only its own tree) extracts at least one document; the other five Solidity entries (c02, c05, c10, c15, c20: another compiler line, or a monorepo package whose imports need remappings) and the Go entries of c17's system (c01, c07, c12: packages that import generated code) extract none; at least 7 of the other 11 Go entries extract at least one document.

No entry derives a law of its own label rule (label_rule_laws 0 in all 20 rows): PAR's sub-forms need codec or Go-role sidecars, NAT needs a versioned machine, and the typed rules over the one expected Solidity document do not hit its label.

Every finding (REFUTED law), if there is any, is unreplayed: with no binding no witness replays on real code, so the true_defect, intended_asymmetry and model_defect counts are 0 and precision is 0 or null.

regressions.claim: The exit (H8): results/eval/holon/corpus.json has one row per corpus entry, in corpus order, with the row keys; not_run exactly when no document was extracted, then with a non-empty reason and every failed document's reason.
Construction: every row's inputs and label are its corpus entry's, and its tree is prefix^{tree} in the instrument's clone.
Construction: the locus, sites, localization, classes, detections and summary are the instrument's (S1-S6), and the instrument's verdict turns on planted rows.
Construction: the laws are the derived ones with their records' statuses, stored documents have their sha256, and Bend re-checks every REFUTED counter-law.
Determinism: holon eval holon --check reproduces a subset byte for byte.

Nothing in M0-M3 changes (no I51 commit touches their laws, results, gen, spec, facts, replay, tests or a holon/ file outside holon/eval/), and the runner names no corpus system, imports no test module and is in no generator closure; the CI gates, freeze check and frozen suite stay green.
